_schema.classes: confirmed = both sides of the same-head-SHA rerun pair carry full evidence under the origin's rule (results files present, head SHA verified by two sources, no environment drift such as a moved base); suspected = same head SHA but weaker evidence. Never summed.

keys.build_timings: same key as processed_builds; one entry per results-bearing build since schema v2: tests_total_s (summed test durations across invocation files), test_count, wall_clock_s (finished minus started), result, truncated (pytest stopped early; total not comparable to complete runs), files_parsed/files_expected (partial fetch detection). Filters like successes-only are the reader's job; nothing is filtered at write.
keys.flakes: origin|repo|job|nodeid; job is the normalized target (e.g. e2e-predictor), stable across branch renames
